passages.text: Imported projects live under data/workspace/projects. Uploads and generated reports have separate folders.
A folder outside AllowedProjectRoots requires explicit human approval before inspection. The agent cannot approve the folder itself.
Knowledge uploads accept at most 15 files per batch, each no larger than 8 MB. PDF and DOCX text is extracted locally.
Before reading a file, resolve its canonical path and ensure it remains within the approved project root. Reject symbolic links.
Knowledge search embeds the question, retrieves vector candidates from Qdrant, and reranks them before supplying evidence to the agent.
Deprecated documents remain stored for restoration but are excluded from normal knowledge retrieval. Restore changes their status to active.
Uploading identical text under the same filename and unchanged embedding configuration returns unchanged and skips generating new embeddings.
Searchable PDFs are extracted locally with page references. A scanned PDF requires OCR and explicit upload consent before using an external PDF provider.
Handoff answers can be exported to Markdown, PDF, PowerPoint, SVG and PNG after review.
The default chat provider is local Ollama using an installed qwen3:8b model. Hosted chat is separately configured.

questions.query: What happens when a project folder is outside AllowedProjectRoots?
Can a scanned PDF be sent to an external provider without asking?
Does uploading an identical document generate embeddings again?
